title: Associate Director of Student Activities
description:
Position Overview

This Associate Director contributes to our vibrant campus
environment through the support and development of student
organizations. This position will be the primary point of contact
for tools and services that support our 200+ student organization
community. This Associate Director will specifically focus on
facilitating organizational training, assisting in the development
of leadership curriculum, and planning co-curricular programs that
enhance student wellbeing and engagement. The Associate Director of
Student Activities- Student Organizations/Leadership Development
will collaborate with organization leaders and campus stakeholders
to enhance the holistic development of the Butler University
student body.

Responsibilities

Responsible for the administrative oversight and leadership
training of more than 200 recognized student organizations.

Deliver and evaluation leadership curriculum and initiatives
offered by the Office of Student Activities.

Supports all recognized student organizations and provides
guidance to them in the execution of their group activities,
including assessing risk management, ensuring policy compliance,
sharing programmatic best practices, attending meetings and events
as needed, and connecting organizations to office/university
resources.

Assists in the oversight of Butler Engage, our student
organization management software used for monitoring organizations
and tracking involvement opportunities.

Supervises, mentors, and evaluates the performance of Student
Leadership Consultants that are tasked with the facilitation of
leadership programming focused on skill development across the
eight dimensions of BU|BeWell.

Develop, Implement, and Assess student organization policies
and procedures with a focus on risk mitigation

Review, Create, and Implement leadership programs, trainings
and processes that develop student leaders and enhance student
organizations as well contribute to the University and the Division
of Student Affairs' strategic plan.

Plans, implements and assess the annual Student Involvement
Fair and other co-curricular involvement opportunities.

Develops, implements, and evaluates the annual Student
Leadership Banquet in collaboration with Student Government
Association and other university stakeholders.

Develops collaborative relationships with faculty and staff for
purposes of increasing student involvement, building community, and
creating co-curricular student development opportunities.

Other duties as assigned


Required Qualifications

Master's degree in Student Affairs, Higher Education, or
related field with 2+ years of related experience.

Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity and
inclusion

Experience advising college students

Understanding of college student development theory

Experience working with students/ student organizations to
ensure compliance with university policies and procedures in event
planning, travel, and other operations

Expertise planning and implementing skill-based training and
leadership development programming

Command of technology including student organizational
management software (Engage), space reservation systems (EMS),
social media and other online tools.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in office suite, with an emphasis on excel.

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
